title: Assistant Manager - Accounting
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------

Responsible for supporting the organization’s financial accounting, reporting, Process Improvement & Automation, statutory compliance, internal controls, and month-end/year-end closing processes. The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, analytical capabilities, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and business teams.  
  
The role will also be responsible for creating, Managing, monitoring and reviewing Alteryx based Finance Processes. Further this role would require indirect oversight of the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of outputs received from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and other relevant finance operations.

Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking, and experienced Assistant Manager.

This role will be a full-time position based out of our Pune office.

Responsible for supporting the organization’s financial accounting, reporting, Process Improvement & Automation, statutory compliance, internal controls, and month-end/year-end closing processes. The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, analytical capabilities, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and business teams.

The role will also be responsible for creating, Managing, monitoring and reviewing Alteryx based Finance Processes. Further this role would require indirect oversight of the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of outputs received from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and other relevant finance operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Accounting & Reporting**

* Manage and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of general ledger accounting, journal entries, provisions, accruals, and account reconciliations.
* Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting packs.
* Perform balance sheet reviews and ensure timely resolution of aged or unreconciled items.
* Analyze financial results, identify significant movements and variances, and provide appropriate explanations.
* Ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, including **US GAAP / IFRS**, as relevant to the organization.
* Support consolidation and group reporting requirements, where applicable.
* Review financial information and accounting outputs received from other ABC teams to ensure consistency with controllership and reporting requirements.

**Financial Controllership & Internal Controls**

* Maintain a strong financial control environment and ensure compliance with established finance policies and procedures.
* Review key financial processes and controls to identify control gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and supporting evidence for accounting transactions.
* Support internal control testing, risk assessments, and remediation of identified control deficiencies.
* Provide indirect oversight of key finance outputs from ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, and other relevant processes, ensuring that risks, exceptions, and variances are appropriately identified and addressed.
* Drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across controllership processes.

**Audit & Statutory Compliance**

* Coordinate with statutory, internal, and other auditors and ensure timely completion of audit requirements.
* Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documentation, and responses to audit queries.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of agreed corrective actions.
* Support statutory and regulatory compliance requirements applicable to the organization.
* Coordinate with tax and compliance teams on matters relating to GST, TDS, corporate tax, and other statutory requirements, as applicable.

**Month-End & Year-End Closing**

* Drive timely completion of month-end and year-end closing activities in accordance with the finance calendar.
* Review accruals, provisions, prepayments and other key accounting areas.
* Ensure accurate cut-off and appropriate accounting treatment of transactions.
* Monitor open items and ensure timely resolution before reporting deadlines.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement, Commercial, Operations, and other functions to resolve finance and accounting matters.
* Provide accounting guidance to business stakeholders on complex or non-routine transactions.
* Work closely with shared service/finance operations teams to ensure adherence to accounting and reporting requirements.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management based on accounting and financial analysis.
* Establish effective review mechanisms with ABC teams to monitor the quality and timeliness of process outputs.

**Process Improvement, Automation & Alteryx Solutions**

* Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of finance processes.
* Create, Manage, Review & Monitor Alteryx workflows supporting finance and controllership processes.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of Alteryx outputs used for accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and reserve calculations.
* Support finance transformation, ERP, reporting, and automation initiatives.
* Develop and monitor appropriate financial controls, SOPs, checklists, and process documentation.
* Promote standardization and best practices across finance processes.

**Team Management**

* Review work performed by team members and provide guidance on accounting and controllership matters.
* Support the development and mentoring of junior finance team members.
* Ensure effective prioritization of activities to meet reporting and compliance deadlines.
* Coordinate with process owners across ABC teams and provide guidance to support consistent and accurate deliverables.

**Qualification & Experience**

* **Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.**
* **Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience**, preferably in Finance Controllership, Financial Reporting, Accounting, or Audit.
* Experience in a multinational organization, large corporate, Big 4, or similar professional environment would be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of **US GAAP / IFRS and financial reporting principles**.
* Good understanding of statutory audit, internal controls, and financial compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with **Alteryx**, including creation of workflow, workflow review, output validation, issue resolution, and process documentation.
* Experience with ERP systems such as **SAP** and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working in a global or shared-services environment would be an advantage.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong technical accounting and financial reporting knowledge.
* Experience in process automation and Alteryx-based finance solutions.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and financial controls.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under tight reporting deadlines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to independently identify issues and drive them to closure.
* Process-improvement and automation mindset.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work collaboratively across functions.
* Ability to exercise effective indirect oversight over cross-functional finance outputs.
* Ability to review and guide the work of junior team members.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

A qualified Chartered Accountant with at least 5 years of post-qualification experience who combines strong technical accounting expertise with a practical business mindset. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in financial closing, reporting, balance-sheet governance, audits, compliance, internal controls & process automation using Alteryx.

The candidate should also be capable of reviewing and validating outputs from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and Rebates, identifying risks and variances, and ensuring timely resolution through effective stakeholder management. The ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, while guiding junior team members and supporting continuous improvement, will be essential.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Sr. Site FP&A**

**Job Summary**

If you are a Finance professional, Emerson has an exciting role for you! We are looking for a Financial Analyst to work with our Financial Services Group in Pune.

We value autonomy, self-reliance, fast movers, a passion for robust and ability to maintained quality of financial reporting.

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Manage the **monthly reporting** process, ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information to Site/BU/WA stakeholders.
* Responsible for monthly, quarterly and annual actual financial closes, meeting reporting deadlines and explaining variations.
* Analysis & Review of **SG&A cost centres** and provide commentary for major deviations
* **Support in monthly Forecasting, Mid Year Review and Annual Budgets**
* **Provide support for internal and external audit requests**
* Analysis & Review of monthly Financials before TB load in HFM & post HFM upload
* Review **Monthly Journal Entries** for GL postings
* Analysis & replies to Queries from Site controllers/WA/BU Finance operations.
* Supporting/Performing **Site POR** (Rolling Budgets) activities as per WA timelines. Discussions with business managers for Orders Funnel, preparation of till date data & forecasting for rest of the year.
* Drive Clearing of Balance Sheet open & aged items regularly mainly for accounts Bank reconciliation, Petty cash, Tax balances, Payroll related GL’s, advances to suppliers, lease accounts etc.
* Create and maintain Invoice coding database for recurring vendors and ensure correct invoice coding for all the supplier’s invoices and approval through Esker system.
* Working on Various **MIS** Reports for finance stakeholder mainly management decks.
* Ensure Intercompany recharges are calculated on time and invoices sent for payment.
* **Site level profitability analysis**
* **Cash flow** preparation on monthly/ quarterly basis & update to Site Controllers
* Ensure **foreign currency exposures** are reviewed and validated on monthly basis.
* Review & Analysis of Site **Headcount** as per HR & SharePoint and make sure correct reporting of Cost centres
* Maintenance of appropriate Internal Controls and compliance with SOX and CP&P

**Who You Are:**

You promote high visibility of shared contributions to goals. You quickly and significantly take action in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Finance Professional (CMA/CA/MBA Finance) with minimum 6-7 year of work experience in FP&A Domain
* Hands on experience in ERP, MS Office, and reporting tools
* Self-starter, suggesting and implementing improvements to the processes.
* Balance stakeholder, Situational adaptability, manages complexities & Manages ambiguity.
* Ability to think creatively, driven, and self-motivated.
* Demonstrated ability to roll-up your sleeves and work with team members in a hands-on management capacity.
* High standards of accuracy and highly organized.
* Flexible to work as per World Area/sites timelines especially during month ends & any specific requests
* Qualified Chartered Accountant, CMA
* Basic understanding of Accounting Principles and US GAAP
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* System Knowledge of Oracle, Hyperion Financial Management
* Power BI or related presentation tools

**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**

title: Analyst IB Finance
description:
Date live: 10/14/2026

Business Area: Finance

Area of Expertise: Finance

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000118013

  

Join us as an Analyst IB Finance at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful as we deploy finance responsibly to support people and businesses, acting with empathy and integrity, championing innovation and sustainability, for the common good and the long term.

  
  

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications:**

* Experienced with MS office toolkit (Word, PPT, Excel, Access Database etc)
* Qualified accountant
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both formal and informal settings & ability to interact with the region and UK / US as part of a global team (written and verbal) Strong control awareness – in particular, the ability to identify and escalate potential control breakdowns and to streamline processes in an effective and efficient manner.
* Has the initiative and ability to break down problems into components parts and resolving them.
* Attention to detail and analytical.
* Confident and assertive manner
  

  

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**

* CFA/master’s in finance / financial engineering would be an advantage
* Article ship / Industrial trainee in mid to large sized firms
* Audit exposure in large financial institutions / banks preferred.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Ensure the maintenance of a strong internal control environment. Review key controls, adjustment substantiation and New, Amends & Cancels trades review, as well as job-specific skillsets.

This role will be based out of Pune.

**Purpose of the role**

To manage the financial operations of the organisation, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of financial reporting.

**Accountabilities**

* Management of the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial statements, and other accounting records in accordance with the relevant accounting standards, rules and regulations.
* Support in identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Development and maintenance of a robust system of internal controls to safeguard assets, ensure that there is no fraudulent misreporting, and ensure the accuracy of financial data, including regular assessment of the effectiveness of internal controls addressing any weaknesses or gaps. .
* Development and implementation of up-to-date financial policies and procedures to ensure consistent and effective financial practices across the organisation.
* Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of financial systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate financial systems with other enterprise systems.
* Preparation and submission of statutory and regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports.
* Coordination with external auditors and regulatory authorities in support of audits and examinations.

**Analyst Expectations**

* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Finance & Operations Executive
description:
**Job Title: Finance \& Operations Executive**  
**Location: Pune (Local candidates only)**  
**Work Mode: Hybrid (Farm Visit/Bank)**  
**Compensation: ₹30,000 – ₹40,000 per month**  
**Experience: 2–5 years**

**Role Purpose:**  
This role is responsible for maintaining farm\-level financial discipline and operational cost tracking across multiple managed farms. The candidate will ensure that every farm operates with structured financial visibility and accurate expense control.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Farm\-Level Financial Tracking**

* Record and manage farm\-wise expenses (Ex. Like A–J farm clusters)
* Track cost heads like:
* Labour cost
* Seed \& material cost
* Fertilizer / input cost
* Operational expenses

**Accounting \& Documentation**

* Record sales and purchase invoices in accounting systems
* Maintain complete documentation (GRN, invoices, delivery records)
* Ensure proper ledger classification and data accuracy

**TDS \& Compliance**

* Handle TDS deduction entries on applicable payments
* Support basic compliance documentation

**Reporting \& Excel Work**

* Prepare farm\-wise MIS reports in Excel
* Maintain budget vs actual cost tracking
* Support monthly financial summaries for management

**Budgeting \& Planning Support**

* Assist in farm budgeting and cost planning
* Help management understand cost per farm / per crop

**Field Coordination**

* Travel to farms in Pune region when required
* Support on\-ground verification of expenses and operations
* Coordinate bank or vendor visits if needed

**Must Have Skills:**

* Strong experience in sales \& purchase accounting entries
* Hands\-on knowledge of TDS deduction \& posting
* Strong Excel skills (MIS, reports, basic analysis)
* Experience in inventory or stock tracking preferred
* Ability to work with multi\-location data (farm\-wise tracking)
* Comfort with field visits \+ operational environment

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

* Practical accountant / operations finance background
* Experience in agri\-business, manufacturing, logistics, or multi\-site setup
* Detail\-oriented and execution\-focused
* Comfortable working in startup \+ field\-heavy environment

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently based in Pune?
* Are you comfortable traveling to farms and handling on\-ground work in Bank (within Pune region)?
* How many years of experience do you have in accounting/finance?
* Do you have hands\-on experience in recording sales and purchase invoices?
* Have you worked on expense tracking for multiple locations/projects (e.g., branches, sites, farms)?
* Are you comfortable managing and tracking expenses like labour cost, material cost, and operational expenses?
* What is your current salary?
* What is your notice period?

title: Finance Transformation Consultant
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.


**About the role**
==================

Job Summary
  

The Data Analytics Sr. Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining advanced reporting solutions that support strategic decision\-making across the organization. This role leverages data analytics to uncover insights, optimize performance, and enhance business intelligence capabilities.
  

This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to


grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more


sustainable society.


We are looking for a Finance Transformation Consultant to join our Finance \& Analytics team, based


at our Centre of Excellence in Pune, India. This is an opportunity to lead how Finance processes are


understood, redesigned, and standardised across a global organisation \- working at the intersection of Finance expertise and structured problem\-solving, in a team that genuinely welcomes new ideas. If you are a strong Finance professional who thrives on diagnosing process challenges, framing solutions, and driving real change, we want to hear from you.  



**About the role**

Our Finance \& Analytics team sits at the centre of Sulzer’s effort to standardise and improve


Finance processes globally. We develop and roll out digital tools that support month\-end close, cost


controlling, and financial reporting across our legal entities \- and we are growing our capability in


Pune to meet an expanding project agenda.


As Finance Transformation Consultant, your primary contribution is Finance process knowledge and


consulting capability: the ability to walk into a process, understand how it works, identify where it


breaks down, and define what a better solution looks like. You will frame requirements, align


stakeholders, and drive solutions to adoption \- in a team that values independence, intellectual


curiosity, and a bias toward action.  



**Your key responsibilities**

* Drive Finance process diagnosis and improvement: Analyse existing Finance processes \- particularly in month\-end close, cost controlling, and management reporting \- to identify gaps,inefficiencies, and opportunities for standardisation across Sulzer’s legal entities
* Frame and structure requirements: Translate Finance process problems into clear, well\-structured briefs that technical colleagues, BI developers, and digital tools can act on \- ensuring the Finance logic is sound before any tool is built
* Drive rollout and adoption: Own the end\-to\-end delivery of process improvements \- from stakeholder alignment through configuration, testing, and rollout of Power Apps, SharePoint List, and Power Automate–based solutions that support knowledge transfer and month\-end closing process coordination, to user training and adoption tracking
* Collaborate across functions and geographies: Work closely with Finance stakeholders, BI developers, IT, and the broader Finance \& Analytics team across multiple time zones \- managing your own workstream and communicating proactively to keep projects on track
* Contribute to the team’s transformation agenda: Bring forward ideas and proposals for how we can tackle problems more effectively \- whether through process redesign, smarter use of data, or the application of emerging digital tools including AI

**What you’ll need to succeed**

MUST HAVE \- EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE


* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in a Finance role with direct exposure to process improvement \- ideally in controlling, FP\&A, or financial reporting
* Proven ability to independently diagnose a Finance process problem, structure it clearly, and write a brief that a technical colleague can act on
Experience managing your own workstream across geographies and time zones, with examples of stakeholder communication without close supervision  
* 

MUST HAVE \- SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES


* Strong analytical and structured thinking skills \- you approach problems logically, define them precisely, and communicate your reasoning clearly
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to work effectively with Finance stakeholders, technical colleagues, and senior leadership across cultures
Fluent in English to a professional standard  
* 

SHOULD HAVE / NICE TO HAVE
